_comment: How much a shared relationship is worth as evidence, for the KB reasoning layer (hypothesize.py), the graph projection (export_graph.py) and the calibration store (calibration.py). These are the SCORING WEIGHTS behind an attribution call, so an analyst must be able to retune them — promote a relation, demote one that keeps over-merging — without editing Python. NOTE THE DIVERGENCE, it is deliberate and load-bearing: `uses_favicon` is attribution-grade for the GRAPH projection (it draws an edge) but only CORROBORATING for hypothesis scoring, because a favicon is easy to copy and the graph is read by a human who can discount it while the scorer is not. Keep the groups separate; do not 'tidy' them into one list. RULE 1: relationship names only, never case data.

attribution_rels._comment: Relations that carry attribution weight in hypothesis scoring — the top of the IntelAnalysis triage ladder. A shared value here is owner-tied: a registrant, an owner-verified token, an analytics property, a payout wallet.

identity_rels._comment: Of the attribution relations, those an operator legitimately reuses across MANY of their OWN domains. They get the generous fan-out allowance.

service_rels._comment: Third-party SERVICE tokens a shared SEO/marketing agency spreads across UNRELATED clients. Same tier as identity_rels but a much stricter fan-out cap, because they over-merge — this is the agency-suspect control.

corroborating_rels._comment: Relations that SUPPORT an existing hypothesis but may never establish one alone — template, CSS, comment, theme, favicon, on-page contact. Same-kit evidence: two tenants of one builder share all of these and share no operator.

noise_rels._comment: Relations that must never contribute to a hypothesis at all. A managed nameserver is shared by millions of unrelated domains.

graph_strong_rels._comment: Relations drawn as the BACKBONE of the domain projection — attribution-grade for a diagram.

graph_bridge_rels._comment: Drawn, but weaker: real cross-cluster bridges such as a shared contact handle. Enough to show a connection, not enough to assert one owner.

graph_kit_rels._comment: Same-kit relations shown only as node context or weak edges, never the backbone of the graph.

relation_labels._comment: Short human labels for the shared-artifact classes, used on graph edges. Edit to change what a reader sees without touching the projection logic.

confidence_probabilities._comment: Confidence label -> the probability it asserts, ICD-203 flavoured. This is what turns a written judgement into a number for Brier scoring, so changing a value re-scores every past call: adjust it only deliberately, and prefer --prob per record for a finer scale.
